chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abdullah, from al-Fudayl, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said regarding adultery: 'Five characteristics remove the water of the face, cause poverty, shorten the lifespan, anger the Beneficent, and necessitate eternity in the Fire. We seek Refuge with Allah from the Fire.'
ai.seo_question: What are the five spiritual and physical consequences of adultery according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the multifaceted impact of adultery, linking spiritual corruption with tangible worldly consequences such as poverty and reduced lifespan. In Shia tradition, these five traits are often interpreted as both physical signs and metaphysical realities, emphasizing how the sin alienates the believer from divine mercy and ensures eternal punishment.
